0.original: Helmhart of Highbridge could use an adventurer's assistance with a hair-raising problem.

1.original: Helmhart has a grievous physical ailment which requires immediate treatment. Slay phurbles around Highbridge to obtain three bottles of phurble blood, and deliver them to Helmhart with all speed.

2.original: You have successfully obtained the requisite bottles of phurble blood. Hasten back to Helmhart and deliver them before his condition deteriorates.

3.original: Helmhart concocts a potent hair tonic with the phurble blood you retrieved. Apply it liberally to his head, that his locks might flow forth once more.

4.original: Having applied the hair tonic to his shiny pate, Helmhart rejoices at the pleasant tingling sensation it affords. Whether it has any effect beyond this remains to be seen.

24.original: Slay phurbles to obtain their blood.

25.original: Deliver the bottles of phurble blood to Helmhart.

26.original: Apply the hair tonic to Helmhart's head.

48.original: You! Yes, you! Adventurer! I need you to fetch three bottles of phurble blood, and do so with all haste!

49.original: Where to find phurble blood, you ask? Why, from phurbles, of course! Now hurry! This is a matter of life and death!

51.original: Well? Have you brought the phurble blood I asked for? If so, then hand it over, and quickly now!

52.original: At long last! My friend, you're a godssend! Now, how did it go? Ah, yes─stir twice, a dash of spittle, shake thrice more, and...voilà!

53.original: Well, what are you waiting for, friend? Grab yourself a dollop and start spreading─my scalp cries out for succor! Oh, and do try not to miss a spot.

55.original: My, that tingles! Why, I can already feel my pores opening! In no time at all, I'll have flowing locks a fulm long!

56.original: I can't thank you enough, friend. What with the sun beating down the way it does in these parts, a bald pate is a potentially fatal affliction.
